7.9.26 Alarms
The Alarm mechanism of the AUTOSAR Operating System provides services to activate Tasks, set Events, increment Counters, or call an Alarm call-back (OsAlarmCallbackName). As stated above, Alarms can only be bound to a Counter which resides on the same core. Tasks can be activated and Events can be set with an Alarm action regardless of the core to which the Task is bound. The access rights defined by OS-Applications have to be respected, however. Additionally it shall be allowed to manipulate Alarms when they are bound to other cores. The API-services SetRelAlarm, SetAbsAlarm, and CancelAlarm can be used to manipulate parameters of Alarms on other cores.
